reader_verdicts.what_it_sells: A EUR 80 canvas weekend bag with a removable shoulder strap and internal zipped pocket, intended to carry my things on short trips.
reader_verdicts.relevance_feedback: The profile explicitly establishes that I left the weekend bag in my basket, so the reminder is relevant. The email additionally assumes that the basket remains available, but it does not establish why I abandoned checkout, whether I still need the bag, or whether shipping cost was the obstacle.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I placed the weekend bag in my basket without completing checkout.
Email-only: The basket is still saved and can be resumed.
Email-only: I may want to reconsider and complete the purchase.
reader_verdicts.problem_now: The unfinished purchase is documented, but no current problem or urgency is established. On a rushed Tuesday morning, this can wait because the email explicitly says there is no deadline.
reader_verdicts.stopped_at: The shoulder strap can be removed, while the zipped pocket sits inside the bag.
reader_verdicts.biggest_doubt: I still do not know the total delivered price; shipping is deferred until checkout and may have been the reason I stopped.
reader_verdicts.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me the shipping charge and total delivered price for my basket.
fixes: Cut the repetitive line "The shoulder strap can be removed, while the zipped pocket sits inside the bag." because it merely restates the preceding sentence.
Rewrite "The price is EUR 80, with shipping charges shown at checkout." to state the actual shipping charge and total basket price.

Shorten "There’s no deadline in this note—just a simple way to pick up the purchase you started. Visit your basket when you’d like to look over the bag and continue from there." to "Your saved basket is ready whenever you want to review the total and continue."

emails.subject: Your weekend bag is waiting
emails.preview_text: Revisit the details and continue from your basket whenever you’re ready.
emails.headline: Take another look at the weekend bag
emails.body:
The CanvasTrail weekend bag is still in your basket. If you’d like to revisit it, your basket is ready when you are.

It’s a canvas weekend bag with a removable shoulder strap and an internal zipped pocket. The shoulder strap can be removed, while the zipped pocket sits inside the bag.

The price is EUR 80, with shipping charges shown at checkout.

There’s no deadline in this note—just a simple way to pick up the purchase you started. Visit your basket when you’d like to look over the bag and continue from there.
